items.title: What exploited vulnerabilities have in common: A data-driven analysis of real-world attacks
items.summary: Real-world exploitation concentrates in a small, high-impact subset of CVEs. Learn how defenders can prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitation likelihood, exposure, and potential blast radius.The post What exploited vulnerabilities have in common: A data-driven analysis of real-world attacks appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Microsoft Security Research, Yair Tsarfaty and Or Begam
